Name: Hey. You're Cursed
Author: VotriValley
Description:
[left]
[img height=100]https://i.postimg.cc/mr2dHLWR/a76e74c2-f59f-49ec-9823-e6609725522a.png[/img][/left]
[color=#D4D4D8]A paranormal story mod where cursed objects, strange broadcasts, and supernatural entities slowly enter your Stardew Valley life. Investigate each haunting, make choices, build bonds, and uncover what should have stayed hidden. [/color]

[img height=100]https://i.postimg.cc/g2KSjwQk/7b4ddcb3-23d7-4284-87d6-7075daf9200d.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]SMAPI[/b], then extract the mod into your[/color]

[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.
Launch the game through SMAPI.
When updating, delete the old mod folder before installing the new version. [/color]

[img height=100]https://i.postimg.cc/bvN6tyc7/2b55be07-4e1f-4b0e-8581-b7ad934421fb.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Supernatural story events and cursed encounters
• Unique entities with their own stories and relationship systems
• Choices, secrets, puzzles, and multiple story outcomes
• Controller, keyboard, and mouse support
• Designed to stay compact and friendly with large mod setups
• v1.0 begins with the first case: [b]Sudoku and the Cursed VHS[/b] [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.0+[/url]
[img height=100]https://i.postimg.cc/L8VC5qw4/009524da-4b58-4b28-acd4-5f343fd3ea91.png[/img]
English, Vietnamese, French, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Thai.*
*Thai requires a compatible custom-language/font setup.[/color]

I may add more languages in future updates, but I probably won’t be able to cover every language myself. Community translations are very welcome! If you’d like to translate the mod into another language, feel free to contact me first and I can provide the latest localization files.
[img height=100]https://i.postimg.cc/HLsSyY1D/f28e381e-317f-4641-9bbc-d491a2c2ddc3.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to [b]ConcernedApe[/b], [b]Pathoschild and the SMAPI team[/b], the Stardew Valley modding community, and everyone who helped test, break, and improve this strange little haunting. 👻[/color]

[line]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]AI disclosure:[/b] AI tools were used during development for coding assistance, localization support, and promotional artwork. Final design, implementation, testing, story direction, and release decisions were manually reviewed and curated.[/color]

[line]
